items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Well, I just asked him if he wanted to come join, and he said, 'Yeah, that sounds all right.' So I said, 'Well, I'll put together a band then.'

ctx.x: Now, how did you generate this new edition of the band?
Well, I just asked him if he wanted to come join, and he said, 'Yeah, that sounds all right.' So I said, 'Well, I'll put together a band then.' And I got some of the people back.
